heroHeadline: Day 792: Motorcyclist Ambushed in Mazatlán, Carjacking Shootout in Culiacán, as 'El Dron' Is Arrested in César Gastélum Influencer-Killing Case
heroSubtitle: 792 days of cartel civil war: on September 22, armed men ambushed and killed a motorcyclist in Mazatlán's Colonia Emiliano Zapata, state police repelled gunfire from armed civilians near Las Bateas south of Culiacán (two detained, weapons and a stolen truck seized), and two teenagers were detained after an armed Land Rover carjacking attempt triggered a shootout with security forces on downtown Culiacán's Avenida Venustiano Carranza. The same day, ministerial agents executed a formal arrest warrant in Puebla against Jesús Alberto 'El Dron' Hidalgo, the chief suspect in the August 4 livestreamed shooting death of TikTok influencer César Gastélum outside a Culiacán KFC. Noroeste's cumulative tally rose to 3,885 violent deaths, 4,424 kidnappings and 12,552 vehicle thefts since September 9, 2024, with September's projected toll easing to 145 deaths. It follows a September 19–21 run in which SSPC and Navy personnel repelled a cartel attack and captured nine in the Sinaloa–Durango sierra, a mechanic and two other men were found dead across Culiacán and El Fuerte, and an unidentified body was found beside the Humaya Canal north of Culiacán. Days of open civil war: 792+.
